title: UTIL_WINDOW_TICKS is a code constant whose comment claims balance.json documentation that does not exist (ODN-5)
detail: The health window it cites lives in data (balance.json: "window_ticks": 200); grep of balance.json shows no util window. ODN-5: rolling-window balance numbers single-source in data — this one is unreachable by catalog tuning, and the comment misdirects.
recommended_fix: Move the window to balance.json (health-section precedent) and read it via cat.balance, or delete the 'documented in balance.json' sentence and justify code-residency in the comment.

title: PIPES section label and noc_panel_rows default hardcode 90 while the row predicate reads tunable pipe_red_pct from the catalog
detail: Half-migrated: behavior is data-driven (pipe_red_pct is a playtest tunable in balance.json) but the title and the measure-pass default restate 90. Retuning the catalog silently makes the section header lie.
recommended_fix: Format the section title from cat.balance.warnings.pipe_red_pct (tprintf "PIPES AT/OVER %d%% (HONEST)") and drop the magic default by requiring the argument.

title: NOC section titles restate catalog numbers (6 PKT, 512 PKT) that the code below reads from the catalog
evidence:
cur = noc_section(v, cur, scroll, visible, "QUEUE DEPTH VS E9 BOUND (6 PKT)")
	bound := u32(max(1, cat.balance.lane_queue_packets))
...	cur = noc_section(v, cur, scroll, visible, "POOL VS E22 CAP (512 PKT)")
	cap := u32(max(1, cat.balance.pool_max_packets))
detail: Extends the pre-existing '(6)' pattern: labels hardcode lane_queue_packets/pool_max_packets two lines before reading them from data. Catalog retune makes the titles lie (ODN-5: never restated in code).
recommended_fix: Build both titles with tprintf from the same catalog values already fetched (bound/cap), so label and bar can never diverge.

title: line_rate_bytes_per_tick is production-dead and its comment mislabels it as 'the honest utilization reference'
detail: Only units_test.odin calls it. The actual utilization path (util_pct_window) uses served_units×100/(window_ticks×capacity_units) and never touches it — the comment points readers at the wrong reference.
recommended_fix: Delete the proc (and its test pins) until the follow-up per-class-bytes work needs it, or fix the comment to say it is currently unused.

title: Bundles struct doc still says 'pure function of the Topology' but now carries rolling flow history reset by every rebuild (including era fire)
evidence:
// change (rule 1); never serialized (pure function of the Topology). One row
...
	tx_slot_tick: [dynamic]u64, // per-slot last-write tick (0 = never written)
	tx_served:    [dynamic]u32, // per-slot served bandwidth-units that tick
detail: The tx ring is flow-step history, not topology-derived; bundles_rebuild also runs at era fire, so honest-util displays zero for up to 12 s after era flips. Placement is workable but the struct's documented contract is now wrong.
recommended_fix: Update the Bundles header to scope 'pure function of the Topology' to the bundle rows and note the tx ring's rebuild-reset (era fire included) semantics.

title: Work served at tick 0 is permanently invisible to bundle_tx_window (slot key 0 collides with the never-written sentinel)
detail: A tick-0 record leaves tx_slot_tick == 0, indistinguishable from never-written; st > lo (lo=0) excludes it from every window, so early-run utilization undercounts by tick 0's work. Display-only, one tick.
recommended_fix: Store tick+1 as the slot key (0 stays a true sentinel) or add a written flag; adjust bundle_tx_window's bounds accordingly.

title: '96 px chip' comments in units.odin and main.odin are stale after TRAY_CHIP_W grew 96→112 in this same diff
evidence:
// format_rate_compact — the tray-chip variant (the 96 px chip budget):
...		// standard = 100 Mbps). Compact form fits the 96 px chip; the NOC rail
...	// constants so the port is faithful. 2026-08-23 (v2-network-units): 96 -> 112

TRAY_CHIP_W :: 112
detail: The diff resized the chip but the new comments it also adds still cite the old 96 px budget — future width tuning will reason from contradictory numbers.
recommended_fix: Update both comments to the 112 px chip / 86 px text zone (or reference TRAY_CHIP_W instead of a literal).
